name: JwtSign
description: Creates a signed JWT (JWS). Supports HMAC (HS256/384/512), RSA (RS256/384/512, PS256/384/512), and ECDSA (ES256/384/512) algorithms.
syntax: JwtSign( struct claims, any key, [string algorithm], [numeric expiresIn], [string issuer], [string audience], [string kid] )

params.name: claims
params.description: JWT payload claims. Standard claims: sub, iss, aud, exp, nbf, iat, jti. Custom claims allowed.

params.name: key
params.description: Signing key. For HMAC: string or byte array. For RSA/EC: PEM string or Java PrivateKey object.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: JWS algorithm: HS256, HS384, HS512, RS256, RS384, RS512, PS256, PS384, PS512, ES256, ES384, ES512. Auto-detected if omitted.

params.name: expiresIn
params.description: Token expiration in seconds from now. Sets the 'exp' claim.

params.name: issuer
params.description: Token issuer. Sets the 'iss' claim (overrides claims struct).

params.name: audience
params.description: Token audience. Sets the 'aud' claim (overrides claims struct).

params.name: kid
params.description: Key ID to include in the JWT header.
